High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Applicant :- Mintu Prajapati And 3 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikram D. Chauhan,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned Aga for the State.
2.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants for quashing the charge sheet dated 15.12.2022 as well as cognizance order dated 21.01.2023 passed by Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-Ist, Court No. 12, Jaunpur and entire proceeding of Case No. 60 of 2023 (State Vs. Mintu and others) arising out of Case Crime No. 196 of 2022 under Sections 498A, 323,
504, 506, 427 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Kheta Sarai, District Jaunpur, pending in the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-Ist, Court No. 12, Jaunpur.
3.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-Ist, Court No. 12, Jaunpur
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-Ist, Court No. 12, Jaunpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
After some arguments, learned counsel for the applicants prays that the applicants may be permitted to move appropriate application before the Court concerned as provided under Section 227 of the Cr.P.C.
4.

This prayer has not been opposed by the learned A.G.A.
5.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the applicants are permitted to appear before the concerned court within 15 days from today and move an application under Section 227 of Cr.P.C.

1 claiming discharge.

6. For a period of 30 days, no coercive action will be taken against the applicants.
7. With the above observations, this application stands disposed of.
